findings.title: [P1] Bind imported vendor modules to the verified runtime inventory
findings.body: Runtime verification hashes the configured inventory, but these imports are accepted solely by version strings and shared module identity. Neither check establishes that NumPy, SciPy or Torch was loaded from that inventory. A preloaded module or a same-version package reachable through site configuration can therefore execute outside the positively verified runtime, and all subsequent identity checks still pass. The isolated interpreter flag does not disable site configuration. Check the running interpreter and imported package origins against verified runtime members, and reject preloaded or externally resolved dependencies before scientific execution.

overall_explanation: The filesystem store and stage dispatch generally follow the frozen contracts, but runtime hashing is not connected to the actual vendor modules imported for scientific execution. This leaves the required positive runtime binding incomplete. Review was read-only; no tests or external data were accessed.
